label: v0.1.0 — Auction Hub MVP scaffold + Expired Rookie Pool table
description: Initial auction module. Tab strip with Expired Rookie Pool populated; FA Auction Pool, Nominations, Cap & Roster War Room, Bid History, and Rules & Calendar are placeholder tabs for future PRs.

this_release: Expired Rookie Pool table (eligibility: contract_type='Rookie' AND contractYear=0)
Filters: position chips, prior owner, min Y3 salary, search
Sortable columns (Player / Pos / NFL / Age / Prior Owner / Rookie Slot / Y3 / Current Bid)
Nominate-action hover popover: current high bid, your proxy bid, cap delta @ $1K/$5K/$10K (informational — offseason has no $300K ceiling per league_context §6.A1)
deferred: Nominate / bid worker endpoints (parked in CROSS_CODEBASE_ALIGNMENT §4.1)
Nominations live feed (12h rolling cadence enforcement on submit)
Cap & Roster War Room (loaded-contract counter, cut-then-rebid blocklist)

rules_added_with_this_release: §A3 ERA nomination cadence: 1 nomination / 12-hour rolling window per franchise (Keith 2026-05-18)
§A3 ERA AAV escalator computed off winning bid (Keith 2026-05-18)
§C2 5-loaded-contracts cap: enforcement at contract-load time, hard block

changes.summary: Initial scaffold + Expired Rookie Pool table. Look-and-feel mirrors Rookie Draft Hub (dark theme, tab strip, sortable table).
